properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-19 for Mission Bay's third real-buildings pass (remaining uncovered footprints inside the official Mission Bay North/South redevelopment-area boundary): The J. David Gladstone Institutes' Mission Bay headquarters at 1650 Owens St: a 6-story, ~200,000 sq ft biomedical research building, completed and dedicated in December 2004; UCSF-affiliated independent nonprofit research institute, named for founder J. David Gladstone. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: of the sentence above, only 'independent nonprofit research organization with an academic partnership with UCSF' is confirmed by readable sources (SF YIMBY 2023-02-16; Gladstone's own 2026-03-25 release); 'named for founder J. David Gladstone' and the December 2004 dedication rest on the cited UCSF 2004 page, which returned 403 to automated fetches and could not be read. The earlier caveat's ~105,000 sq ft expansion figure was wrong for 1650 Owens: SF YIMBY gives 200,000 to 275,000 sq ft (about 75,000 added); 105,000+ sq ft is Gladstone's March 2026 lease of new space at 1450 Owens St. REPLACED 2026-10-12 (shape; status and use unchanged): the owner approved building records whose outline matches an Assessor lot at 85% or better, both ways, using the lot (CLAUDE.md, 'An official parcel beats our drawing'). DataSF's Assessor layer (data/raw/parcels.geojson) has Assessor lot 8709008 (5,570 m2, active, mapped 2001-03-20); the earlier outline of 3,240 m2 and the lot overlap with IoU 0.58 (100% of the earlier outline lies inside the lot and it covers 58% of the lot). The outline is now that lot using the lots' own vertices (no simplification). geometry_type stays 'real'.
